description: A pair of white curtains hangs from a gold curtain rod. The curtains are made of a light, flowing fabric that drapes gracefully. They are partially drawn, revealing a neutral background. The overall presentation is clean and minimalist, suggesting a modern or contemporary setting. The gold rod adds a touch of subtle elegance, complementing the simplicity of the curtains. The fabric appears to have a soft texture, and the way it falls suggests it's a medium-weight material, providing some privacy and light diffusion.
